title: Find the Perimeter of Real Objects in Centimetres

instruction.text: Work out the correct length for each side of the triangle and fill in the gaps. The triangle is an equilateral triangle.
instruction.sound: Work out the correct length for each side of the triangle and fill in the gaps. The triangle is an eequilateral triangle.

hint.text: Equilateral triangles have three equal sides.
hint.sound: Eequilateral triangles have three equal sides.

instruction.text: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the triangle? Select the correct answer.
instruction.sound: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the triangle? Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. You work out perimeter by adding all the sides together.

instruction.text: What is the perimeter of the triangle? Write the correct answer.

atoms.finishSound: The perimeter of the triangle is 18 cm.

instruction.text: Work out the correct length for each side of the book and fill in the gaps. The book is a square.
Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the book? Select the correct answer.
instruction.sound: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the book? Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. You work out perimeter by adding all the sides together.

instruction.text: What is the perimeter of the book? Write the correct answer.

atoms.finishSound: The perimeter of the book is 60 cm.

instruction.text: Work out the correct length for each side of the stop sign and fill in the gaps. The stop sign is a regular octagon.

hint.text: Regular octagons have eight equal sides.

instruction.text: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the stop sign? Select the correct answer.
instruction.sound: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the stop sign? Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. You work out perimeter by adding all the sides together.

instruction.text: Which sum is the equivalent of the addition sum? Select the correct answer.
instruction.sound: Which sum is the equivalent of the addition sum? Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. You work out perimeter by adding all the sides together.

instruction.text: What is the perimeter of the stop sign? Write the correct answer.

atoms.finishSound: The perimeter of the stop sign is 16 cm.
